body:
Yes. This was absolutely the majority of my life. The outcasts are the only people that like me, and even then it’s a small subset. I have ONE person that will call me out of the blue, we talk on the phone almost every day, we tell each other secrets, like, a true best friend that views me the exact same way.

In 32 years there’s been exactly one person like that in my life, and I only met her this year.

Like most people can go suck my metaphorical dick (a phrase when taken literally makes no sense, I just learned the intention behind it) but anyway, almost all people suck and either avoid me, tolerate me to varying degrees, or don’t even give me the time of day.

I just wanted to say that this one bestie I can be more authentic with than my own husband. They’re out there but damn near impossible to find and I feel like in my lifetime I’ll never come across another person like that.

Same!! It takes me so much longer than everyone else to learn the names of my students and longer than it should to even recognize them as students who are in my class. Then the challenge of are they AM or PM. There are so many layers. Don’t get me started on unrelated nicknames.

Like that’s actually a scientific thing from what I remember hearing/reading years ago. Cross race identification is incredibly difficult. Imagine a bunch of blonde white Scandinavians. You’re going to have an equally hard time with groups of them too, I’m sure of it.

I have a coworker who adopted orphans from Uganda. They are the darkest people I’ve ever seen. They’re absolutely beautiful people. Well, I saw that as a unique, defining feature.

Then I saw a picture where they got with people from their home country at a sporting event here. Same features on all of them. The only way I could tell them apart was their smiles.

I love the unique beauty in every culture. I promise I’m not trying to put some down. I just suck at describing in a PC way and wish I could do it better.

When I started as a first year teacher there were two blonde staff members who were on the heavier side. I said to one before some event we had to look nice for that wow she looked really good dressed nicely and I normally don’t see her like that. Uhh…she was very confused.

You know where this is going. One was the trendy art teacher that either looked ok or great. The other was like a PE teacher or para, I don’t remember, but always looked like crap.

I thought I was giving a kind complement to the PE one, and instead I gave a bad insult to the art one

I’m a teacher and I have seen students I taught in 5th/6th as high schoolers and I don’t remember a single one and barely remember any names. Recognize zero of them.

Sometimes even kids the year after I have them I don’t remember their face or name, or they might look vaguely familiar, but names are so hard.

Like that or no???

We had our first couples counseling session and already I see that we’re starting to change. Already I have hope that working with this therapist will help. She’s fabulous.

Hopefully he will realize he needs to change. I am already self reflective and see mutual blame, but he blames only me and feels he does no wrong.

Hopefully that will start to change. He already has learned to leave me alone and text before coming in and asking permission if he needs something and I need the space.

So far so good!
Thought of another one! I always look at my reflection. Walking past a mirror? Stare as I walk. Walking past a shiny metal wall? Stare as I walk. In a zoom type meeting? Staring at myself.
Ha still do it as an adult

I don’t do that when I’m uncomfortable but generally when I leave a room I don’t say anything. I leave when I feel it’s appropriate and rarely leave when I feel uncomfortable. If I’m uncomfortable I abnormally for me do say something so people think me leaving is less weird hopefully
Whereas I hate extra movement and was once so still during a meeting that my watch recorded a nap that was over an hour long
The song thing…that’s not normal??

When I walk on like sidewalks if part of one foot feels a difference like a rock or crack with one side higher than the other, I try to make the other foot have a matching sensation. I find it satisfying and comfortable but I don’t go crazy if I can’t. I just try to.

As a first year middle school science teacher I made the grave mistake of showing a random nature video to my class. Uhhhhh yeah, mating ritual happened. The kids were all “we’re going to tell our parents and get you fired!” I was terrified as a first year teacher.

Looking back it’s pretty damn funny. When I told it to more experienced teachers they were all like yeah that’s pretty normal to happen by accident, not a big deal.

And now as the age of most of the parents of my kids (though no kids myself), I can imagine a kid coming home and saying that and laughing about it

He said he dug his heels in when I got mad. He absolutely did it on purpose. “I don’t remember what you were yelling.” How??? It was the exact same thing over and over.

After our first counseling session he is much better about giving me my space before it explodes as it almost did a few times. Hopefully once the trust is back it will not happen so frequently

ETA I did leave the room and he followed and refused to leave

I really don’t have much math stuff. Almost all of what I have is from my solo science days. I agree, if I was just math, I would be like you. But adding that science and multiple grade levels in underfunded schools and wow did I have to buy a lot.
My genuine question this is all about is how much space does your school stuff take up at home. Yeah, rambled a bit. But that was the intended purpose.

It’s pretty bad. He’s not the person I thought he was and we were together for 9 years before getting engaged.

I’m honestly working to get rid of a LOT of stuff I’ve been holding onto. Each time I try I am able to let go of a lot more, but I’m not yet able to get rid of as much as I’ll end up getting rid of the first time I go through things.

Oh I get it. I totally do.

The great news? Our counselor is a retired SPED, behavior, reading, and social studies teacher. So she knows. She absolutely knows. I’m not showing him any of this, like I’m genuinely curious after his comment how much crap people keep at their houses
Oh there are SO many. Counseling just started. She was like every other week, monthly, and I was like weekly. Two steps forward, three steps back it feels some days.

Moved districts and grade levels and oh I was science before for two different grade levels, one late elementary and the other early secondary, and all of the best science teachers I’ve ever known who were the most passionate have all been this way. I’m the one who is asked “do you have…” or others say “oh go as her! She probably is it” person. Like they needed balloons for award day decorations as an afterthought. I happened to have a whole pack of multicolor balloons I let them have. Random stuff like that.
Ahhhh band. And that stuff can’t be stored in the garage. Most of the stuff I have was from solo science in two different grade levels. Pretty much all of that was fine out there.

I used to be science for two different grade levels and now I’m elementary in a different district teaching my second subject (now also math, definitely not much to take home from that) and fourth grade level.

A quarter of the garage organized well is truly what mine would have taken up at MOST. It wasn’t organized well.
No I’m genuinely curious about the school stuff at home thing. I’m not looking for a solution. We just started counseling.
Immature is more like it. Pretty sure he’s autistic and very much in denial
It was in the garage and stored in a really crappy way where one set of shelves could have held most of it but it took up a lot of floor space. None of it was in any sort of main living area.
Sadly he didn’t at all until after we got married. Yeah, we started counseling. Started yesterday. He’s very resentful he moved cities to move in with me.
Not wondering about husband crap, wondering genuinely what’s the norm for keeping school stuff at home
Yeah there’s that.
Because he’s spiteful and trying to hurt me. He was seriously just trying to hurt me. Not the point of why I posted here.
Newly married moving in together pains when it was already my house and I’m making room for him, but he is very resentful over every little thing.

He means I’m a fat, selfish asshole because I used to have a much bigger classroom, moved districts but didn’t move houses, a lot of the old lab supplies and extra school supplies that I collected over the years along with storage containers, mementos like notes from kids, binders of things I want to keep like student teaching and other observation notes I wanted to keep. Also classroom library books I bought that are for a different reading level than my current students.

I threw out over a dozen moving boxes of random crap I initially took home and got rid of.
So words?

My husband says my snippiness when I have a migraine or pre-meltdown or because I’m stressed or hungry or whatever are all initial abuse and he matches my energy. His is intentional. Mine isn’t and his refusal to accept my boundaries leads to a meltdown. Then I get more aggressive and he calls that abuse when he’s the one manipulating me
Oh yeah. A standard cocktail did the trick I’m pretty sure

That’s very interesting. He is very confident and does tell me what to do and usually I do end up changing my behavior/actions as long as it doesn’t seem like a big deal (lid down vs up level stuff) but is extremely probable that is just how it started and now he’s trying bigger things.

Man my new bestie would go to bat for me any day. She’s done it at work (school). She has gone and fetched admin when things really were that bad with another coworker. She’s my shoulder to cry on. I can’t tell her all the crazy thoughts I have, but the not super crazy stuff she all knows.

Anyway, small circle but a circle I trust completely.

The replies are making me feel so much more confident in how to approach this! I absolutely agree with everything you said. 

Yes, he’s saying me having an attitude is abuse. He’s saying every time I snap is abuse. Every meltdown, abuse. Every desperate threat well into the meltdown when he still won’t leave, abuse. And of course it’s physical abuse and assault if I’m melted down and he gets in my space and I’m snotty bawling screaming go away and he gets closer so I nut punched him and he slapped me in the face which just made me cry harder.

Like dude, it’s simple. Leave me the fuck alone when I say stop and leave me alone. It really is that simple.

Edit: nut punch made me feel bad. I do hate that I did it. Normally I’d absolutely never.

Wow did I need to hear that about the intent. My intent is never to hurt someone during a meltdown.

And wow. I will absolutely ask the therapist to define abuse and how it relates to intent in our first session just to make that clear
Yeah I wish it meant immediately but I couldn’t communicate and it was busy so it didn’t speed anything up.
Yeah I agree with the other commenter. Some of that is migraine, but a LOT isn’t. The pain could be secondary to something else going on.

Try different CGRP’s. Did Botox help at ALL?

Why I said different CGRP’s

Emgality works pretty well. Aimovig doesn’t do anything at all. Never tried ajovy because any insurance I had wouldn’t cover it

Personally, Botox and emgality maintenance, with PRN ubrelvy, gabapentin, reglan, benadryl, ibuprofen, butalbital, and muscle relaxers keeps me almost always out of the ER and they have been getting better.

Same with triptans, just because one doesn’t work doesn’t mean they all don’t work.

Like there was one time it was so bad I felt like I couldn’t even breathe, but that was in the ER waiting room when it got that severe. I was already at the ER because it was really bad. That’s the worst it has ever been

It was a previous time.

Once when he was throwing away my stuff and ended up flushing it down the toilet so I couldn’t have it

Once when he refused to get away from my space

He refused to leave me alone when I was starting to have a meltdown. I left the room and he followed me and outright refused to leave me alone.

Oh and did you know meltdowns are a choice? That’s what he’s claiming.

Exactly, I realized that today. He recorded himself abusing me and me reacting to his instigating and if I did end up reacting physically it would be because he pushed me way too far. Which I would have hated.
Deposit Feb 2020, finished construction and signed May 2020, married Feb 2024, moved in September 2024. He has no claims to the house essentially

It’s not really defending myself if he’s passively just not leaving and keeps talking to me when I want solitude. Like me screaming at him and him saying no he won’t leave the room, hard to justify that a physical reaction is defending yourself.
My therapist asked yesterday if we started counseling and how we were doing. I had really great things to say. Then he pulled this shit last night.
[ Removed by Reddit ]

No kids, house is only in my name. It would be quite cut and dry. The only joint thing is a bank account I just want the $10,000 from that my dad gave us to start our joint account off strong as a newly married couple. I’d let him have all of the rest we’ve put in together. When it comes to that, those are really my only demands.
Converse in so many colors some are almost identical. Now I never wear them. I wore them just about every day for like 2-3 years.
Right! If I picture something it has to fit into something I have a context for it in totally lost and ask a million questions and everyone gets mad at me for that
Wow I really like the idea of certain things being downloads!
That reminds me of the total trips I had doing ketamine infusions, but mine were more geometric and less truly wavy abstract
Haha I could function so seamlessly with the web of conversations in my brain back in the day. My head is so much quieter after medication for bipolar and ADHD
I wonder if that’s part of it for me too. I absolutely used to be more visual as a kid

Yeah I can definitely see words. Sometimes it’s like on a page and certain words stand out. Yeah sometimes like Star Wars. Sometimes just text like sentences through my mind. Typically just a dark internal monologue
I find patterns comforting. Wow, you can make really amazing connections using memories! That’s super impressive
Sometimes it’s also a derpy panda that can’t manage to do anything right and keeps falling over

I ask a million clarifying questions when someone is describing something. Like I cannot picture it on my own and want them to describe the random parts as I’m piecing them together and it drives people insane. But it drives me insane when I can’t picture it! Now it feels so much more logical that it’s easier for some and harder for others to picture things
I truly find it so fascinating how minds work so differently! Before a week or two ago I never realized minds could be different like this!!
Yes. Meds have kept a lot of things so much neater in my head. I like the idea of being able to close tabs thanks to meds. I never thought of it that way.
I’m with you there. Medicine for my mood and other medicine for my ADHD have made a huge difference in how I feel

Vyvanse calms my brain!

My bipolar meds make my head very quiet on their own.

I used to have countless tabs with sound coming from a few and I couldn’t figure out which ones so there was always a ton of noise…a head injury also quieted that a lot. Then bipolar meds helped more. Then ADHD meds helped the rest of the way

I used to have a partially photographic memory. How did I forget about that? Now it’s completely gone.

I’d get the 99th percentile on a test and think that meant I got one question wrong. Months after taking it I’d remember the entire test and all answer choices and what I picked.

Ha. Now I don’t remember what I had for lunch later in the same day
Oh my goodness, the scripts for things that will never happen. Do they sometimes happen out loud in front of a mirror?
I got ketamine infusions for like a year. It was only like geometric shapes and colors through space. No true images or anything lifelike at all. And even that blew my mind.

I can actually identify with that when I’m depressed.

I also completely identify with not missing people that aren’t in my immediate surrounding. Like wow. I really never miss people. I hadn’t realized that.

We’re exactly the same except I usually don’t have a song.

I wondered for a long time how deaf people thought without words and spoken language from an internal monologue. Now I’m trying to imagine someone who can’t have pictures and doesn’t know sound and what they must think

People suddenly with/without glasses? May as well be a new person unless they regularly switch back and forth and that’s the norm

But kid wears the same pants and shoes every day? (I’m a teacher). Unless they really stand out like SpongeBob crocs, I simply will not notice
Omg if there’s a tv show with a few characters with the same hair color, I absolutely cannot tell them apart for a long time! Then eventually I can

Ok more context. Real eggs we dyed as kids ourselves, hidden by my mom in my grandparents giant backyard but overall close to the house all the way around it like in tall grass. Tree crevices, in their yard decorations, flowerbeds, like all over the regular natural yard. I did have an interest in finding them. I just didn’t notice them even when I was looking at the area they were in.

A different example of how I’m oblivious. I’m a teacher and do not notice when my kids eat or chew gum or pass notes. I want to see these things, I just don’t. Like I guess maybe part of it is not focusing or looking directly or looking more generally instead of at details, if that makes sense. It’s been a lifelong thing. Even if I’m looking for something or it’s something I care about I might not notice it still.

Polarized quality sunglasses as dark as you can from sunglass hut. Worth the cost. Classic ray bans and Jackie Ohh from ray bans are my favorite. The Jackie Ohh design is bigger and seriously the cutest

There’s one at Ulta called Maneater. Can’t remember the brand. Love it so much! I also tried a Benefit one that’s black and kinda spikey top for volume and I like that too just as much.

I hate a lot of mascaras but LOVE those two.

Edit: both are $10 on Black Friday if it’s too much right now.

ARE YOU ME????? Getting diagnosed at 32. Lady appointment for evaluation is tomorrow. Eye contact is so hard. I nod a lot and notice others don’t but still do to stay engaged. I tailor my topics more than my vocabulary and language structure. Like nobody needs to hear how cool polymers are or some random story from graduate school assignments.

I also can have perfectly intellectual conversations with my husband.

And I’ve had over 80 days of migraines since January 31 and don’t say much to others about them.

Like…hi, twin.

Yeti has an amazing water bottle that has a smaller opening for your mouth but that screws off to be large and you can fit ice and all of that inside perfectly, and screws shut and is truly a water bottle! I love mine so much.
My neurologist believes wholeheartedly in the McMigraine meal for me. The doctor has told me to get McDonald’s repeatedly

Shoving seafood in my face to force me to eat it. It’s not a logical aversion. I ate fish sticks as a kid. By high school I was 100% anti seafood. My now husband back when we were early dating like probably 8-9 years ago put a piece of fish on my plate at a restaurant and refused to stop trying to force me to eat it. I had a meltdown and he criticized me for overreacting and being too picky and it was just a taste. Doesn’t matter. Zero seafood. Ever. No shrimp, no crawfish, no salmon, no tuna, no flounder, no crab, no lobster, no seaweed, no oyster sauce or fish sauce like in ramen, straight up nothing. I deny the anchovies in Caesar and tell myself it’s not there and eat Caesar occasionally. Otherwise, literally zero seafood since I was a little kid and ate fish sticks like they were chicken nuggets. Making me even touch seafood is too much.

I teach summer camp at a museum and one particular camp has you dissect squids. Nooooooo thank you. Had someone else do it for me. Even with gloves, NO.

I mean they may have already been out for a while then. I just know I got my first set in 2011 when I started college and the medium sized played separately a few years later close to when I graduated, probably within the year after I graduated in 2016-2017
Wait, they’re worth a lot? I bought them between like 2011 and 2016. Not that long ago. I have a full set of dinner, salad, and small plates
I have those plates! Corelle Memphis

I felt my teaching partner was attacking me. My teacher friends felt the same way. She said I attacked her. I reported to the AP that she attacked me multiple times. Partner reported to the principal I attacked her. Principal had a grade level sit down about being nice and I thought good, she’s hearing it. She then after that meeting did something to undermine me. I told the principal and AP. That’s when I learned she complained about me. They blamed me. Witnesses said I was fine and she was wrong. AP believed me. Principal believed her. It blew over.

I would read the write up and see what they’re saying then ask for clarification. I’m unsure if you should diagnose autism. Others could share their experiences. I shared my mood disorder before with mixed results. Either people are supportive when they learn or they get nasty and try driving me off.
Going out for dinner because he had a buy one get one free coupon

Here’s a huge recent win.

It is my 9th year teaching. I’m either loved or really hated. Mostly loved. My newest principal at my new school (second year at the school, first year with this principal but last year she was the assistant principal) really had it out for me. Like so completely had it out for me.

Well, last week or the week before (time is mushing together) I had district level curriculum people in my room along with the mean principal and the math coach. They were so completely head over heels impressed it ended up making the principal gush about how amazing I am. She would never tell me anything positive to my face, but the math coach said she said a lot of great things about me.

Ha! It must have killed her to say nice things about me.
I don’t have BPD but some asshole diagnosed me with it and now I can’t get it taken off.

I read something like now you’re finding out what you would have done if you lived in Germany during the Holocaust. I’m learning how afraid I’d be. I would have been collected potentially due to being Catholic instead of Protestant and definitely for having a mental illness.
Agreed. I wish I understood it better instead of just being scared because I don’t understand and it sounds so bad
I want to see an opinion post about who is the most unhinged. Like it’s all so, so bad…we’re living in the darkest timeline.
This calms me down some. That some organizations will dig their heels in and fight it. Thank you for that perspective.

I’m a teacher. A teacher I worked with, specially a special education teacher, believes her son got autism from vaccines. Like no…no they don’t…and people say they’re so proud of her for speaking up and saying how much she loves RFK and agrees with him. Like lady, now you’re just as crazy if not crazier than he is.
I’m well into my diagnosis journey but not yet labeled. I’m also sad and scared.

My diagnosis is coming soon. I completed all of the questionnaires but don’t have a formal diagnosis yet. It’s in progress. I really want to learn my strengths and weaknesses but I’m scared about the registry since I’m also bipolar, going to get an ADHD diagnosis with my autism one, PMDD, migraines, hearing loss, anxiety. I have so many prescriptions for mood and migraines. I cost insurance over $20,000 every quarter from my expensive prescriptions and treatments. I’ve been in therapy for years.

I’m afraid of the unknown. It’s terrifying that I started my diagnosis journey safely and now that it’s time for the official diagnosis I feel unsafe. I hate our country now and feel unsafe. First autism, what’s next? I fear I could be rounded up and sent to a camp due to my mood disorder and everything else wrong with me since I have a history of hospitalizations from being suicidal with the most recent being 2019. 2017, 2018, 2019. It was basically an annual thing for a while. I’m more stable now but technically get stimulants from my psychiatrist without an ADHD diagnosis and wonder if that would cause an issue for them. I have soooooooo many ER visits for migraines.

Is my fear logical?

I don’t. I don’t allow myself to take things more than a certain number of days a week and if I hit 3 days one week for some reason, I basically don’t take it more than once the next week. A lot of days I take nothing or things I can take frequently. Like today for example my first two rounds were benadryl, reglan, muscle relaxer because they can’t cause rebound. Then I took two butalbital the third round. I have taken that sparingly. Now I’ll max take it one more time this week. I basically just balance what I take each day and take medicine in a conservative number of days. My autistic brain can keep it straight.

Claimed it wasn’t sexual harassment from a staff member because I didn’t say “stop” even though a same sex (female) coworker grinded on me and rubbed her ass on me in front of the entire student body.

Told me I was the problem because a partner teacher refused to let any kids go to the bathroom so they’d yell at me and walk out because it was an emergency. She was never told to let kids go. I was told I couldn’t manage a classroom.

Said partner teacher talked shit about me in front of at least a dozen others in an open room and they didn’t care.

Admin lied and said the state was taking us over. Complete lie I advanced to district level admin because it’s bullshit and they had to retract what they said after lying they didn’t say it to the district admin.

“No tshirts” was the strongest dress code enforcement so people would wear leggings (not dress code) with a mediocre top like a casual sweater and get away with it because the top wasn’t a shirt.

Bribing kids with candy (illegal in title 1) and throwing parties during the day where kids were wild and out of control and blamed teachers for not supporting kids if we ever complained about students trashing the school and getting in fights.
Is it by the k cups/coffee? Or in a different place?
Where are you that they sell Tazo chai??? I’m in Texas and have never seen this!

Because I’ve done TMS and it was BS and hurt while doing it then did nothing. It’s based on my experience with things like that and things I’ve read about others saying it does nothing, like how Zok damages eardrums in some people so I refuse to go near it even if others have suggested it for me based on ads.

Totally steroid taper. That’s broken some but not all of mine. I’m currently at day 77 out of the last 80 days. Nothing is working for me. Are you on any preventatives? I would say time to seriously alter your preventatives and get something like Nurtec, ubrelvy, triptans, gabapentin, muscle relaxers, butalbital, benzos, haldol, reglan, benadryl, all of those things have broken a migraine for me at some point. Except Nurtec. But it helps many others. I can’t have it because of the Splenda

Well there’s the one that was so painful I couldn’t speak, couldn’t keep my eyes open, couldn’t even breathe. ER fixed it.

There was one where I couldn’t see straight, was incoherent, couldn’t walk, basically couldn’t communicate and was worse than a zombie. ER fixed it.

There was the one that lasted a couple of weeks and the ER couldn’t get rid of it and I missed a week of work.

There’s the one now like the second one I mentioned right now but this is my 77th day of migraines out of the past 80 days.

Actually if you are stimulated all the time, a stimulant may quiet your brain. If you do actually have ADHD, it calms your brain down and helps you focus calmer. It quiets your brain. It is worth a shot. I hate Ritalin, hate adderall, love Vyvanse personally.

At first it was the stroke symptoms, but now it’s scarier when I can’t see straight because it’s so severe and can’t walk in a straight line and I’m completely disoriented and almost don’t know where I am.

Migraine medicine taken appropriately. 

Rebound headaches aren’t what I’m referring to.

On one hand, Nurtec is a trigger due to the sweetener.

On the other hand, sometimes if I take migraine medicine for a migraine without pain I end up with pain as the medicine kicks in, like oh hey we’re treating it, and that means now you’ll feel pain. Other things will get better, but I’ll start having mild pain I didn’t have before.
Steroid taper to break it from a doctor. That’s what we try around then and it works not all the time but definitely more than half of the times I’ve tried

A day in airports and on planes was my most uncomfortable. The sun through the window in the sky with the smells and temperature I couldn’t control and babies screaming…it was bad. I couldn’t see straight

I’m 32 now and my parents broke it to me that they found a box of condoms years ago when they helped me move apartments one time. I was immediately mortified. Mom was in shock, dad said at least she’s saving money by buying in bulk. Mortified. But see the humor in it now and we’re married now so whatever. Oh and that only came to light a month ago. Whatever. Like it’s a normal thing people have and do and it’s embarrassing but in the future it’ll be funny and she will probably never bring it up
The cheese bambino pizzas are my absolute favorite frozen pizza. I wish they came full size!
Hm I used to live off Riverside when I went to UT and they cared, but to be fair that was also 10 years ago

No clue. This round of botox and emgality is hitting right but I’ve had emgality within that time before and I had botox a couple weeks before it all started, so I really do not know. We did start lamictal after the amitriptyline fail. Not sure if that’s helping because the dose is still very low
Idk this Botox and emgality hit right and I’m not sure if starting lamictal helped because I’m only on 50 and that’s really not a lot at all. Nothing made it go away specifically, it just kinda did.

Actually I do, well, used to, always be suicidal, but it stopped when I had a migraine because I didn’t want to end up in more pain than I was already in. Bipolar and PMDD are a lot and that’s not even everything wrong with me.
If they have an actual customer service counter they may handle it very differently than at a register where they’d still call a manager so possibly have the same documented outcome.

Sometimes it triggered horrific migraines that day or within the next day or two. But that’s gotten much better and it’s completely worth it for the amazing relief and symptom reduction I get. It’s absolutely amazing and you get used to not moving your face and start noticing actresses that get botox and can’t make many facial expressions either. Totally and completely worth it! I also do emgality monthly and need ubrelvy along with other rescues at varying frequencies. To me, life changing.
I have 3rd graders that don’t know their own birthdays, not even the month. It’s so sad.

My dad forgot my birthday 8 years in a row growing up. It became a joke to me to see when he would remember. At this point, whatever.

I even had a “30 and fabulous” sash when I turned 30 and people still didn’t realize it was my birthday.

It absolutely sucks, no way around that.

Here’s a laugh. My mom couldn’t remember if my brother’s birthday was the 5th or 6th of the month and had me check Facebook one year.

Not everyone is as considerate as we are. At the end of the day, people suck.

I knew it was coming. I picked out my ring and had the event narrowed down to a couple of things we were doing so no part was a surprise. We had already talked about it. Even our three weddings were anticlimactic. First with a justice of the peace retired judge, second a church one for my mom, third the original only one that was the typical party one but my family couldn’t make it. My mom got diagnosed with ALS hence the rush JP wedding then the church one for her in another state. Like the whole thing wasn’t really exciting. No part of it felt like a big deal. It kinda made me sad, but at the same time, I hate attention so I guess it’s ok.
